currentParagraphText: “I don’t think comparing our situations makes much sense,” Artemis shook her head. “You already far surpass anything I had accomplished when at your level. That includes my comprehension of concepts. You may think you’re bad at it, but that’s only because you’re trying to understand concepts that someone of your level shouldn’t even be touching upon. And if they did, it would be in a school of magic you were highly specialized in.”
